newsitem.title: USA: SEC approves Kellstrom warrant exchange.
newsitem.headline: SEC approves Kellstrom warrant exchange.

text.p: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has declared effective Kellstrom Industries Inc's registration statement covering the exchange of 4.6 million warrants into common shares, the company said Wednesday.
Kellstrom said warrant holders would be able to buy a share for $5.
If all warrant holders were to exercise their right, the company would receive $23 million, it said.

Kellstrom said it would use the money to reduce outstanding debt under its working capital line of credit with BankAtlantic Banocorp Inc, finance any future acquisitions, and buy additional inventory and other working capital.
